claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
Ryan Coogler won the Oscar for Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler's Oscar win for Best Original Screenplay for Sinners was his first Oscar win.
Ryan Coogler has five Oscar nominations overall.
Sinners' original story blends Delta Blues history with genre elements.
Blue Moon by Robert Kaplow was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
It Was Just an Accident by Jafar Panahi was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Marty Supreme by Ronald Bronstein and Josh Safdie was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sentimental Value by Eskil Vogt and Joachim Trier was nominated for Best Original Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won the Best Actor Oscar for Michael B. Jordan at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won the Best Original Score Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won the Best Cinematography Oscar at the 98th Academy Awards.
